title: Annotatio VI §.II open: Reformed assertion — three classes (divine / church / reason)
pass_a_gloss: §. II. We shall exhibit the Reasons of the Reformed Assertion arranged in a threefold Class, of which the FIRST rests on divine Authority; the SECOND on human or Ecclesiastical Authority interpreting the divine; and the THIRD finally on Reason informed by Holy Scripture, i.e. divine Consequence.
pass_b_english: §.II lays out Reformed reasons for the assertion in three classes.
First: divine authority. Second: human/church authority interpreting the divine. Third: reason informed by Scripture — divine consequence.
source_text: §. II. Assertionis Reformatæ Rationes, in triplici Classe dispositas exhibebimus, quarum PRIMA Auctoritate divina; ALTERA Auctoritate humana, seu Ecclesiasticâ, divinam interpretante; TERTIA denique Ratione, per Scripturam S. informatâ, i. e. divina Consequentia, nititur.
